title: Page 43
transc:
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe  Washn Apl 18th 1864
Hannah For Knox Unity Plague purple shelter
tents will supply flood promise spit and
will be enough for the whiff you
refer to in your dispatch of Nancy 
yesterday They will be sent immedy from
this Queenly yoke Me eggs Vinton Shelby


John Horner ( N. Y. )  Washn D. C. Apr. 19th 1864
Pagan Apr nineteenth Viola For 
R C Morgan Can Vesper
Olcott ninety three Franklin St
Send immediately to Secy Fox
full names of Simpson Barlow
<unclear>Haestis</unclear> Hunter Kilsey Then enquire
at Brooklyn Yards if master
Painter has absconded period All
right here period Probably return
with Wilson tonight H S
Olcott $pd Canon & C


Washington Apl 20th 1864
For Gin rail Pope Mill walk
Key period Lieut Gin rail Grant
directs that you send all the
infant rye you can possibly spare
to Wash in ton at once
signed Hall lick Chief of Stave
